x: …helmed by the company in his coach - Hyman, Peter Cl[illegible]rk, Brian Fernee, Chapman, Roath, Perkins, Mike Barratt, George Brown, Maynard, Palmer and Sando just to mention a few are not designed to rouse one's confidence.…
Highgate, thro' George Brown, had taken over in 2nd place closely followed by V.P.H. and Blackheath. T.V.H. had dropped to 6th, Poly were 10th and Woodford (last year's record holders) 18th!
We stand a good chance of commencing another run of wins next year as the individual winner, Highgate's George Brown was running his last race in their colours before joining Welwyn A.C.

Laurie O'Hara, who had shown a slight lapse in form in recent weeks, was out for revenge over his Southern victor, George Brown of Verlea, and both were hard on the tails of the leaders after a fast start.
